entries.title: Correct or delete spot readings
entries.description: Management can open a spot reading in Machine History to correct its hours or reading date and time, or delete it. The Audit Log keeps a record of the change.

entries.title: Find jobs by driver
entries.description: The new Drivers column shows who is driving on site. Filter it to find jobs a driver has worked on or is planned for.

entries.title: Find machines by default driver
entries.description: Filter the Driver column in Machines to see the machines assigned to a default driver.

entries.title: Add people who do not sign in by name only
entries.description: When creating a user with a role that cannot sign in, you no longer need to enter an email address or password.

entries.title: Search column filter options
entries.description: Type in a column's dropdown filter to find the option you need.

entries.title: Search for machines by driver
entries.description: Search the Machines list by the default driver's name, alongside code, make or model.

entries.title: Receive service alerts after reading corrections
entries.description: A corrected spot reading now triggers a Service Due Soon notification when it brings the machine within the service threshold.
